title: Louis Douzette's Moonlight Moods
content: Louis Douzette (German 1834-1924) was such a nocturne specialist that he was known as "Moonlight Douzette."Here are some basic tips we can learn from his work:1. Keep the overall value range dark, especially in the outer edges of the picture.2. The color doesn't have to be very blue. The chroma can be very low, almost gray. There can be a little warmth around the moon.3. To convey the effect of lantern light, set up a very subtle warm and cool contrast between the light and the sky.4. Keep the edges very soft away from the light and its reflections.More images onDuckDuckGoImages on Tutta Art Pittura
